'''2025 US Nationals Carson Stockman LS Profit''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Carson Stockman]] at [[2025 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Carson Stockman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2025 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:25Nats Stockman LS Profit.txt |Download]]
